description: This file defines the TestCaseParams class used for handling parameter data in integration test cases within the OrangeHRM project. It includes properties for various test parameters, getter/setter methods, and utility functions for managing test case data.

classes.name: TestCaseParams
classes.description: A class representing parameters for test cases in integration tests for OrangeHRM. It manages test data such as user IDs, services, attributes, expected results, exceptions, and hooks, providing getter and setter methods for each.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the test case.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name for the test case.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the test case.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID for the test case.

methods.name: getServices
methods.description: Retrieves the list of services used in the test case.

methods.name: setServices
methods.description: Sets the list of services for the test case.

methods.name: getFactories
methods.description: Retrieves the list of factories used in the test case.

methods.name: setFactories
methods.description: Sets the list of factories for the test case.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the attributes involved in the test case.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes for the test case.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Retrieves the request body data for the test case.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the request body data for the test case.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Retrieves the query parameters for the test case.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the query parameters for the test case.

methods.name: getResultData
methods.description: Retrieves expected result data from the test case.

methods.name: setResultData
methods.description: Sets expected result data for the test case.

methods.name: getResultMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for the expected results.

methods.name: setResultMeta
methods.description: Sets metadata for the expected results.

methods.name: getInvalidOnly
methods.description: Gets the list of invalid test data parameters.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the test case involves invalid data.

methods.name: setInvalidOnly
methods.description: Sets the invalid data parameters.

methods.name: getExceptionClass
methods.description: Gets the class name of the expected exception.

methods.name: setExceptionClass
methods.description: Sets the class name for the expected exception.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the expected exception message.

methods.name: setExceptionMessage
methods.description: Sets the expected exception message.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns a DateTime object representing the current test time.

methods.name: setNowFromArray
methods.description: Sets the current DateTime based on an array with 'datetime' and optional 'timezone'.

methods.name: getHooks
methods.description: Retrieves all hooks associated with the test case.

methods.name: getHook
methods.description: Retrieves a specific hook by name, if callable.

methods.name: setHooks
methods.description: Sets the hooks for the test case.
